tools.name: uv
tools.why: capture, from-obsidian, lint, organize, and query all invoke logseq-cli.py via `uv run`; each SKILL.md documents a python3 fallback when uv is unavailable

tools.name: rg
tools.why: query's cheapest-first keyword-lookup tier runs rg directly over the graph path before falling back to logseq-cli.py scan

tools.name: curl
tools.why: query's Datalog tier calls the local Logseq HTTP API directly with curl, only when resolve reports api_up: true

config.why: graph resolution for every logseq skill (capture, from-obsidian, lint, organize, query); resolve auto-discovers and can write it when absent
config.remedy: run any logseq skill once and follow its graph-resolution prompt (or pass --write-config after auto-discovery)
